title: A MINRES-based Linesearch Algorithm for Nonconvex Optimization with Non-positive Curvature Detection
summary: We propose a MINRES-based Newton-type algorithm for solving unconstrained nonconvex optimization problems. Our approach uses the minimal residual method (MINRES), a well-known solver for indefinite symmetric linear systems, to compute descent directions that leverage second-order and non-positive curvature (NPC) information. Comprehensive asymptotic convergence properties are derived under standard assumptions.
